questions.question: What event does Jeremiah 52 describe in detail?
options: The return of the exiles to the land
The rebuilding of the temple after exile
The reign of the last king of Judah
The fall of Jerusalem and the exile to Babylon
questions.answer: The fall of Jerusalem and the exile to Babylon

questions.question: What happened to Zedekiah in chapter 52?
options: He fell in the heat of battle defending the whole city
He was captured, his sons killed, and he was blinded
He was freely pardoned and kept on upon his royal throne
He escaped away to Egypt and lived out his days in exile
questions.answer: He was captured, his sons killed, and he was blinded
